name: Top Set Upper / Lower
description: Four long workouts a week for 12 weeks, two upper-body and two lower-body, 8 to 10 exercises each. Every day opens with one heavy top set of a main lift, then lighter back-off sets of more reps with the same lift; the rest of the day is compound and isolation work for every muscle, arms, shoulders, calves and abs included. Each block is heavier with fewer reps; week 9 is a deload. Add weight to the top set when it reaches the top of its range.

phases.name: Volume
phases.description: Top set of 4 to 6, then three back-off sets of 8 to 10 at about 80%

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Up
exercises.notes: Bodyweight to start; add weight with a belt when every set is easy

phases.name: Intensity
phases.description: Top set of 3 to 5, then three back-off sets of 5 to 7 at about 85%

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Up
exercises.notes: Bodyweight to start; add weight with a belt when every set is easy

phases.name: Deload
phases.description: One lighter week: fewer sets and lighter weights, so you start the next phase recovered

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Up
exercises.notes: Bodyweight to start; add weight with a belt when every set is easy

phases.name: Peak
phases.description: Top set of 1 to 3, then two back-off sets of 3 to 5 at about 87%

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Up
exercises.notes: Bodyweight to start; add weight with a belt when every set is easy
